cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong khi them dong; Pivot lay ten Table lam Source nen tu cap nhat vung. Ten khong dau cach, khong ky tu la.
cong_thuc.vi_du: A1:F4998 thanh Table 'DuLieu'. Them dong 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 ngay duoi Table tu nam vao (vung cham).

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nguon la ten Table chu khong phai $A$1:$F$4998 co dinh. Dat sheet moi cho sach; click vung pivot thi hien Pane Fields + tab Analyze/Design.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Source=DuLieu > sheet moi pivot trang cho bao cao 1.

cong_thuc.ten: Keo Fields: Filters / Columns / Rows / Values
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Filters loc tren dau; Columns nhom ngang; Rows nhom doc; Values so lieu tinh. Thu tu keo quyet dinh hinh bao cao.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Filters=Khu vuc (chon Mien Bac), Columns=San pham SP01-SP10, Rows=NPP (FPT, Viettel...), Values=Sum Doanh thu.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: So mac dinh Sum; doi Average xem binh quan, Count dem dong. Moi Values co the tinh khac nhau tren cung pivot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Keo Doanh thu 2 lan: 1 Sum (Tong), 1 Average (TB).

cong_thuc.ten: Show Values As: % of Grand Total
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien ty trong % thay vi tuyet doi; tong 100%. % of Column/Row khi muon ty trong trong nhom.
cong_thuc.vi_du: SP10 5.24%, SP09 9.16%... Tong 100%. Doi ten cot 'Ty le %' o Formula Bar.

cong_thuc.ten: Doi ten cot Values + Number Format
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ten mac dinh 'Sum of Doanh thu2' dai; doi gon. Format nghin + le giup de doc tien te/%.

cong_thuc.ten: Thu gon +/- , Subtotals, Grand Totals, Layout Tabular
cong_thuc.giai_thich: +/- an hien chi tiet (Mien Bac gom bao nhieu). Subtotals tong nhom; Grand tong chung; Tabular dang bang tach cot ro hon Compact.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Collapse Mien Bac chi thay tong vung. Grand Totals Off bo dong/cot tong khi chi can chi tiet. Tabular hien Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu rieng cot.

cong_thuc.ten: Sort + Filter trong Pivot (ke ca Date Filter)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Sort nhan hoac sort theo tong Values (NPP doanh thu tu be-lon). Date Filter loc thang/ngay nhanh cho field Ngay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: San pham Z-A; NPP sort theo Sum Doanh thu nho->lon de thay yeu nhat. Ngay chi lay 3,6.

cong_thuc.ten: Calculated Field (truong tinh toan, mo rong)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Them chi tieu moi tu field co san ma khong sua nguon (vd Hoa hong 5% doanh thu). Tinh tren tong sau gop, khac cot phu Average.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Calculated Field HoaHong = Doanh thu *5%. Keo vao Values thanh cot HH theo NPP.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ngay le co hang tram gia tri kho slicer/loc; group gom ve Thang/Quy/Nam gon. Khac voi chen cot phu MONTH/YEAR o nguon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ngay 1/1-31/12 group Months -> pivot hien Jan-Dec thay vi 365 ngay.

cong_thuc.ten: Cot phu Thang/Nam bang MONTH/YEAR (cach thay the)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Video goi y cach nay thay vi Group: chu dong, lam Slicer Thang/Nam gon, dung duoc ca khi Ngay loi group. Nho Refresh sau khi them cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them cot Thang, Nam; Slicer Thang (1-12) thay vi hang tram ngay le.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Slicer la nut loc lon bam thay vi dropdown. Multi-select chon nhieu NPP; Columns chia nut thanh nhieu cot do roi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nha PP 2 cot: FPT, Ga Excel, Viettel, VNPT. Bat Multi-select chon FPT+Viettel.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: 1 slicer dieu khien dong bo ca 2 pivot/chart (bao cao theo Khu vuc + theo San pham). Quen tick 1 pivot thi bao cao do lech.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer NPP noi ca 2 bang; chon FPT thi ca 2 bang chi hien FPT.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, loc theo pivot. Field Buttons la nut xam tren chart (tien loc) nhung roi khi chup/gui; an cho dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart cot: Mien Nam 40%, Mien Trung 35%. Hide buttons truoc khi copy len Dashboard.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Pivot khong tu cap nhat real-time; phai Refresh sau khi them/sua nguon. Change de kiem tra/sua ten Table nguon khi loi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 > Refresh All thay tong tang 30 o ca 2 pivot + chart.

cong_thuc.ten: Copy pivot lam bao cao 2 + dinh dang tien
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot de lam bao cao 2 ma khong keo lai tu dau (1 theo Khu vuc, 1 theo San pham). Dinh dang tach nghin cho tien.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy pivot sang phai: bao cao 1 theo San pham, bao cao 2 keo Khu vuc>Rows xem theo vung.

quiz.cau: Du lieu bai 20 lon co nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Du lieu lon hay doi nen dung Pivot keo tha.

quiz.cau: Truoc khi tao Pivot nen lam gi?
quiz.B: Tao Table (Ctrl+T) + dat ten lien nhau
quiz.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong, Pivot tu cap nhat theo ten.

quiz.cau: Phim tat tao Table la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ctrl+T mo Create Table.

quiz.cau: Ten Table dat the nao moi dung?
quiz.A: Tuy y dai bao nhieu cung duoc
quiz.giai_thich: Ten space gay loi tham chieu Source.

quiz.cau: Them dong moi ngay duoi Table thi sao?
quiz.A: Tu nam vao Table (vung cham mo rong)
quiz.giai_thich: Day la loi ich lon nhat cua Table.

quiz.cau: Nguon Pivot sau khi tao Table la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ten dong tu mo rong theo Table.

quiz.cau: Chen Pivot o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Di tu Table de tu nhan Source.

quiz.cau: Nen dat Pivot moi o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Sheet moi sach, de lam nhieu bao cao.

quiz.cau: Pane quan ly Pivot ten gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Chua 4 vung Filters/Columns/Rows/Values.

quiz.cau: 4 o keo trong Fields la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Bon vung keo tha quyet dinh bao cao.

quiz.cau: Keo Khu vuc vao dau de loc tren dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Loc Mien Bac/Nam/Trung tren dau pivot.

quiz.cau: Keo San pham vao dau de thanh cot ngang?
quiz.giai_thich: Thanh cot SP01-SP10 ngang.

quiz.cau: Keo Nha phan phoi vao dau de thanh hang doc?
quiz.giai_thich: Thanh hang doc FPT/Viettel...

quiz.cau: Keo Doanh thu vao dau?
quiz.giai_thich: So lieu de tinh toan.

quiz.cau: So mac dinh trong Values khi keo so la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: So thi Sum; text thi Count.

quiz.cau: Doi Sum sang Average o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Chon Average > OK.

quiz.cau: Xem ty trong % tong thi chon gi?
quiz.A: Show Values As > % of Grand Total

quiz.cau: % of Grand Total va % of Column khac nhau the nao?
quiz.B: Grand: tren tong chung; Column: trong cot nhom
quiz.giai_thich: Chon sai mau so dan ket luan sai.

quiz.cau: Doi ten 'Sum of Doanh thu2' dai thi lam the nao?
quiz.C: Click ten > Formula Bar go lai (Tong/TB/Ty le) > Enter
quiz.giai_thich: Ten gon de doc; khong trung ten goc.

quiz.cau: So tien xau chua phan cach nghin thi lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: 1,234,567 de doc; giam decimal.

quiz.cau: Nut +/- truoc Mien Bac de lam gi?
quiz.A: Thu gon/mo chi tiet trong nhom
quiz.giai_thich: Collapse de chi thay tong vung.

quiz.cau: Tat dong/cot tong chung o dau?
quiz.B: Design > Grand Totals > Off for Rows and Columns
quiz.giai_thich: Bo tong khi chi can chi tiet.

quiz.cau: Show in Tabular Form de lam gi?
quiz.C: Hien dang bang tach cot ro (Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu)
quiz.giai_thich: Ro hon Compact khi nhieu cap nhom.

quiz.cau: Sort NPP theo doanh thu tu be den lon thi sort theo gi?
quiz.D: Sort theo Sum of Doanh thu (Values) khong phai ten
quiz.giai_thich: More Sort Options > theo Values.

quiz.cau: Loc Ngay chi thang 3,6 thi dung gi?
quiz.A: Mui ten Ngay > Date Filters/Date Filter chon 3,6
quiz.giai_thich: Date Filter loc nhanh field Ngay.

quiz.cau: Copy pivot sang ben de lam bao cao 2 thi Fields the nao?
quiz.B: Di theo vung paste moi, keo lai tuy y
quiz.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot giu lien ket.

quiz.cau: De co bao cao theo Khu vuc ben canh bao cao theo San pham thi lam gi?
quiz.C: Copy pivot roi keo Khu vuc > Rows o vung moi
quiz.giai_thich: Tan dung pivot cu, keo lai field.

quiz.cau: Ve bieu do tu pivot thi dung lenh nao?
quiz.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, nhay theo loc/slicer.

quiz.cau: Nut xam tren PivotChart muon an khi chup bao cao thi lam gi?
quiz.A: Hide All Field Buttons on Chart
quiz.giai_thich: An cho dep, du lieu van giu.

quiz.cau: Chen Slicer o dau?
quiz.B: Click pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nha PP, Ngay
quiz.giai_thich: Slicer loc truc quan bang nut bam.

quiz.cau: Chon nhieu NPP tren slicer (FPT + Viettel) thi bat gi?
quiz.C: Multi-select (bieu tuong 3 o) roi tick nhieu
quiz.giai_thich: Khong bat thi chon muc 2 mat muc 1.

quiz.cau: Slicer Ngay co hang tram ngay le thi xu ly gon nhat the nao?
quiz.D: Group Months/Years hoac chen cot Thang=MONTH(), Nam=YEAR() lam slicer
quiz.giai_thich: Group/slicer Thang Nam gon hon tram ngay.

quiz.cau: Group Ngay ve Thang lam the nao?
quiz.A: Chuot phai Ngay trong pivot > Group > chon Months > OK
quiz.giai_thich: Gom 365 ngay ve 12 thang.

quiz.cau: Them cot Thang bang cong thuc nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Lay so thang de slicer/nhom.

quiz.cau: Them cot Nam bang cong thuc nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Lay nam de slicer/nam.

quiz.cau: Lam sao 1 Slicer NPP loc duoc ca 2 pivot?
quiz.A: Ve slicer moi cho moi pivot
quiz.D: Chuot phai Slicer > Report Connections > tich ca 2 pivot
quiz.giai_thich: Noi slicer toi moi PivotTable de dong bo.

quiz.cau: Quen tick 1 pivot trong Report Connections thi sao?
quiz.A: Bang do khong nhay theo, lech so lieu
quiz.giai_thich: Phai tick het de dong bo.

quiz.cau: Them dong 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 vao Table roi pivot chua thay thi lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Pivot phai Refresh moi nap du lieu moi.

quiz.cau: Kiem tra/sua nguon pivot khi nghi sai vung o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Dam bao nguon la ten Table dong.

quiz.cau: Calculated Field Hoa hong 5% doanh thu tao o dau?
quiz.D: Fields, Items & Sets > Calculated Field: =Doanh thu*0.05
quiz.giai_thich: Truong tinh tren tong pivot ma khong sua nguon.
